notablePrerequisites: Karametra's Acolyte does not have summoning sickness. Your devotion to green is at least five.
description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Karametra's Acolyte.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
